description: Angular component class for configuring 'check relation' rule node in the Thingsboard UI, including form setup, validation, and configuration preparation.

classes.name: CheckRelationConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending RuleNodeConfigurationComponent for managing relation check configurations.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for the component.
